idProvenance: unresolved-id — no lane row names a node on 1138:13436. One read of that board resolves it.
why: UX-I-38 (Major, dead-end) — two nav rows drill in with a full push animation to a card that never says what the feature is or does, so the upgrade decision is asked for with no information. LockedScreen already takes a per-screen `message` prop (LockedScreen.tsx:36,58) and nothing passes one; the board should draw the message that prop is for.
